authority: The preregistration permits one pilot-only amendment that maps exact rows and keys to already registered quantities without changing the split, endpoint, feature meaning, model, alpha, thresholds, or hypotheses.

capacityAnchor.identity: The first row is CU0, the second is CU1, and later rows are later standardized capacity check-ups.

eisMeasurement.summary: Median z_ref_now_mOhm across frequency rows in one measurement key.
eisMeasurement.checkupAssignment: Measurement timestamp t belongs to capacity check-up j when anchor_j <= t < anchor_(j+1).
eisMeasurement.duplicateRule: If more than one valid spectrum exists at the same SOC in a check-up window, take the median measurement summary.

pulseMeasurement.summary: Separately take the median r_ref_10ms_mOhm and r_ref_1s_mOhm across waveform rows in one measurement key.
pulseMeasurement.checkupAssignment: Use the same half-open capacity-anchor window as EIS.
pulseMeasurement.duplicateRule: If more than one pulse waveform exists at the same SOC in a check-up window, take the median measurement summary.

resolvedMapping.elapsedTime: Use exact timestamp_s differences divided by 86400. Capacity response uses the CU0/CU1 capacity anchors; each EIS or pulse response uses the corresponding CU0/CU1 measurement timestamps after within-window aggregation.

pilotFinding: Raw pulse rows advance timestamp_s through the waveform, so grouping pulse data by exact timestamp would mistake samples from one pulse for distinct check-ups. sd_block_id is the source-provided measurement identifier. The pilot caught and corrected this row-identity error before any non-pilot file was opened.
unchangedContracts: The four pilot cells retain zero model and metric weight.
The endpoint remains first observed standardized capacity check-up at or below 80% of own CU0 capacity, measured from CU1 and right censored.
Feature meanings and nesting A/B/C/D remain unchanged.
The Weibull AFT model, ridge alpha 1.0, preprocessing, metrics, thresholds, and hypotheses remain unchanged.
No target-aware imputation, tuning, recalibration, or row deletion is permitted.
